description: This file contains the implementation of an HTTP client class (Zend_Http_Client) in PHP, including methods for setting request parameters, headers, authentication, handling redirects, and executing HTTP requests.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client
classes.description: A PHP class implementing an HTTP client supporting GET, POST, PUT, and other HTTP methods, with support for headers, cookies, redirects, authentication, and file uploads.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Zend_Http_Client instance, optionally with a URI and configuration.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the request URI, accepting Zend_Uri_Http object or URI string.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the request URI, either as a string or URI object.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the HTTP client.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Defines the HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, etc.) for the request.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets HTTP headers for the request, accepting individual headers or arrays.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific header.

methods.name: setParameterGet
methods.description: Adds GET parameters to the request.

methods.name: setParameterPost
methods.description: Adds POST parameters to the request.

methods.name: _setParameter
methods.description: Helper function to set GET or POST parameters internally.

methods.name: getRedirectionsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of redirects that occurred during the last request.

methods.name: setAuth
methods.description: Sets HTTP authentication details.

methods.name: setCookieJar
methods.description: Assigns or creates a cookie jar object for cookie persistence.

methods.name: getCookieJar
methods.description: Returns the current cookie jar object.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the request or cookie jar.

methods.name: setFileUpload
methods.description: Prepares a file for upload via POST multipart/form-data.

methods.name: setEncType
methods.description: Sets the encoding type for POST data.

methods.name: setRawData
methods.description: Sets raw POST data, potentially from a stream resource.

methods.name: setUnmaskStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables unmasking of array parameters in GET requests.

methods.name: getUnmaskStatus
methods.description: Returns the current unmask status for GET parameters.

methods.name: resetParameters
methods.description: Clears all request parameters and optionally headers and response data.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last raw HTTP request string.

methods.name: getLastResponse
methods.description: Returns the last response object received.

methods.name: setAdapter
methods.description: Sets the connection adapter, loading it if given by name.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Returns the current connection adapter, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: setStream
methods.description: Enables or disables streaming of response data to a file.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the current streaming status.

methods.name: _openTempStream
methods.description: Creates and opens a temporary file stream for response streaming.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Executes the HTTP request with the specified method, handling redirects and response parsing.

methods.name: _prepareHeaders
methods.description: Constructs the headers array for the HTTP request.

methods.name: _prepareBody
methods.description: Builds the request body, handling raw data, encoding, and multipart forms.

methods.name: _getParametersRecursive
methods.description: Deprecated method to flatten nested parameters arrays.

methods.name: _detectFileMimeType
methods.description: Detects MIME type of a file using available PHP extensions.

methods.name: encodeFormData
methods.description: Encodes a form-data part for multipart/form-data POST requests.

methods.name: encodeAuthHeader
methods.description: Generates the Authorization header for HTTP Basic or Digest authentication.

methods.name: _flattenParametersArray
methods.description: Flattens multi-dimensional parameter arrays into key-value pairs for encoding.
